### Important Notes:

- **Total MWe** includes only units ≥30 MWe; older small units (<30 MWe) excluded.
- **PDP VIII (2023)** cancels **all new coal projects** except those already under construction by 2023. Hence, most new thermal capacity is LNG-based.
- **Sources** are official Vietnamese government or state-owned enterprise websites. URLs may change; use site search if broken.
- **Future LNG projects** (e.g., in Bạc Liêu, Quảng Trị) are in early planning; excluded due to lack of firm approval or developer.
- **Retired plants**: Several small coal plants (<200 MWe) retired pre-2020 (e.g., Ninh Bình old units); not listed due to size or lack of public COD data.
- **Technology**: USC (Ultra-supercritical) not yet deployed in Vietnam; all "advanced" coal plants are supercritical.

   - Plant Portfolio: [https://www.pvpower.vn/en/](https://www.pvpower.vn/en/)

4. **Vinacomin (Vietnam National Coal-Mineral Industries Group)**  
   - Projects: [https://vinacomin.vn](https://vinacomin.vn)

5. **Ministry of Industry and Trade (MOIT)**  
   - Press releases and decisions: [https://moit.gov.vn/en](https://moit.gov.vn/en)
